title: [SOLVED] Installing Steam via terminal broke my monitors/resolution?
body: I installed steam via the terminal (I did sudo pacman -Syu, then sudo pacman -S steam, chose the Nvidia option when prompted - I have an Nvidia card) Reset the computer, and when I came back my second monitor didn't turn on and my main monitor is set to a VERY small resolution. Looking in HyprMod, it doesn't give me an option to change the resolution back to 1080, and doesn't seem to be detecting my second monitor at all, and I noticed my first monitor is now appearing as "unknown-1" I'm assuming this is happening because of the Nvidia portion of the install but I'm uncertain what to do about it. I've been searching but all the results I'm finding are quite old and I've been warned not to follow old guides previously on this forum! Last edited by hedwyn (2026-09-01 17:02:18)
